description: Temporary dependency switch until go-git/go-git#2390 (loose-pack-discovery fix, tracked in beadwork-z41) merges upstream. Point go.mod at the fork's bw-pin branch (jallum/go-git@bw-pin, module renamed to github.com/jallum/go-git/v5 since Go requires a module's own go.mod to declare the path it's imported under) instead of upstream go-git v5.17.0. Add a regression test (internal/repo) that reproduces the loose-*.pack failure via real 'git maintenance run --task=loose-objects' run twice, proving Sync fails on unpatched go-git and succeeds against the fork. Revert this pin once an upstream v5.x release including the fix is tagged.
title: Pin go-git to jallum/go-git fork with loose-pack-discovery fix
